unit.why: A brief teaching on praying for righteous sons at Sabbath candle-lighting, followed by a short anecdote told by the author's father about the mother of R. Shmuel of Kaidanov, who prayed in Russian that her son would become a Torah scholar.
unit.boundary_note: the trailing heading 'מענין הוראה' belongs to the next division

stories.start_quote: וזאת סיפר לי הה״ק אאמו״ר זצל״ה
stories.summary_en: The mother of R. Shmuel of Kaidanov could not pray at all, but at Sabbath candle-lighting she prayed in Russian that her son Shmuel would become a Torah scholar.
